title: Design: searching the Categories list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, named for example Quokka Parts.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Type quokka in the search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 2:

  • Category A is listed.
  • The search box is outlined with a clear (x) button, and the label reads the match count with the tier count, as in picture 7.5.
